property.name: Greens Storage Sachse
property.opened: Operated by CubeSmart (store 4568); the signage reads CubeSmart

buildings.name: Main Building
buildings.note: Three-story climate-controlled building, 75.6 x 51.2 m to the outside of the walls (248 x 168 ft on the CSW Sachse unit numbering plans; grid 1-25 at 10 ft along the long side, A-Q at 10 ft across). Office and lobby at the west corner (grid A-D / 22-25) with the entry on the southwest face and a side door to the north parking court; elevators and stairs at grid G-H / 23-24, stairs at grid L / 2-3. Unit numbers start with the floor (1xxx on level 1 to 3xxx on level 3). The 1001L-1011L lockers are a two-tier 3 ft bank in the niche beside the elevators (6 columns on the plan, no numbers): drawn side by side across the bank, order along it assumed.
